text_block_list.text:
Setting her sights on the "Takarazuka 
Kinen" as her next goal, Rice Shower 
devotes herself to daily training, 
receiving cheers and support from 
passersby.

Having received overwhelming support and 
topping the fan vote, she was chosen to 
participate in the opening ceremony at 
Hanshin Racecourse.

First, Rice Shower heads into rehearsal. 
However, due to an accident at the venue, 
her Trainer ends up getting injured.

Furthermore, as long as the cause of the 
incident remained undetermined, they fell 
into a situation where holding the 
Takarazuka Kinen was impossible.
